verdict.rationale: Lever's vendor pages describe recruitment analytics: templated, shareable dashboards that track leadership metrics, trend forecasting with rolling averages, and benchmarks against more than 26,000 talent teams. None of the evidence names the specific funnel metrics the story asks for, so delivery is only implied. missing for 10: explicit stage-conversion reporting, time-to-hire metrics, source-effectiveness reporting, offer-accept rates, per-role/per-team breakdowns, independent or hands-on corroboration.
